<!-- examsstudio-v1:  -->
```{r data, include=FALSE}
exams::initialize_exercise()
.fmt <- function(x, digits = 2) exams::fmt(x, digits = digits, decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")
.locale <- "EU"
.ok <- FALSE
for (.try in seq_len(10000L)) {
  a <- sample(seq(4, 12, by = 1), 1)
  b <- sample(seq(2, 9, by = 1), 1)
  sol <- a + b
  diff <- a - b
  if (isTRUE(a > b)) { .ok <- TRUE; break }
}
if (!.ok) stop("Keine gueltige Variablenkombination gefunden.")
.lab_3 <- c("gerade", "ungerade")
.ok_3 <- c(isTRUE((a + b) %% 2 == 0), isTRUE((a + b) %% 2 == 1))
names(.ok_3) <- .lab_3
.sol_3 <- .lab_3[which(.ok_3)[1]]
```

Question
========
Gegeben sind $a = `r .fmt(a, 0)`$ und $b = `r .fmt(b, 0)`$.

- Summe $a + b$ = `r exams::add_cloze(sol, tolerance = 0, digits = 0)`
- Differenz $a - b$ = `r exams::add_cloze(diff, tolerance = 0, digits = 0)`
- Die Summe ist `r exams::add_cloze(.sol_3, .lab_3, type = "schoice")`

Answerlist
----------
`r exams::format_metainfo("answerlist")`

Solution
========
Summe = `r .fmt(sol, 0)`, Differenz = `r .fmt(diff, 0)`.
